# Shared VS Code settings

[settings.json](settings.json) enables Git repository discovery to depth two.
Opening the `zima` folder directly gives one Explorer root and seven Source
Control repositories: Zima and the six independent members under `projects/`.

Only this README and the portable discovery settings are shared. Other editor
files stay local; machine paths and credentials never belong in these files.
